test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Anand wanted to make a cylindrical kaleidoscope of length 30 cm and radius 7 cm. If he is using handmade sheets to make it, then how much sheet will be required for this?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the cylindrical kaleidoscope (height) = 30 cm

Radius of the cylindrical kaleidoscope = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of the cylindrical kaleidoscope = Curved Surface Area (CSA)

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

Height (h) = 30 cm

Radius (r) = 7 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

CSA = 2 × π × 7 × 30

CSA = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × 30

CSA = 1320 cm²

**The total sheet required will be 1320 cm².**
